verdict.rationale: Elasticsearch has no evidenced built-in natural-language command interface. Natural-language operation is only possible indirectly: an official MCP server (elastic/mcp-server-elasticsearch) lets external AI agents drive Elasticsearch, and official skills teach AI coding agents to work with the Elastic stack. missing for 10: a first-party natural-language console or assistant inside the product, documentation of which operations can be performed via natural language, and independent or hands-on corroboration that NL-driven operation works.
